name: Fae magic
description: A dormant fae magic that awakens in Kellan and lets him lull Akul into a trance.

timeline.summary: Cornered by Akul's thunder, Kellan taps an untouched fae power and lulls the dragon into a trance.
timeline.quote: The dragon lost focus, thunder spinning from his teeth in a harmless sigh.
